one_line: Meta's text-first social network, with a free REST API to publish posts, retrieve media/profiles, moderate replies, and read insights.
auth_notes: OAuth2 via a Meta app with the Threads API use case enabled. Access tokens from the App Dashboard or API; rate limited per user. Free to use.
self_serve_notes: Self-serve: create a Meta developer account and app, add the Threads API use case, connect an Instagram/Threads account, and start calling. No payment; app review not required for basic Threads API access.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: ~15 endpoints: publish (single/carousel posts), retrieve media and profiles, reply moderation, mentions, keyword search, insights, oEmbed, webhooks
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for reply events and other activity

existing_mcp.note: No official MCP found in docs; no well-known community MCP server for Threads API.
